notes.title: UPDATE #10: Hotel Blind now supports virtual reality!
notes.content:
Hotel Blind now supports Virtual Reality!

-Support added for HTC Vive and Occulus Rift
-Implement Radio that player can turn on
-Adjust Window Volume
-Increase footstep sounds
-Upgrade to Unreal Engine 4.13
-Fix for footsteps playing when blocked by object
-Fix for Windows sometimes being detected as corners
-Reduced Player Movement Speed
-Added bathroom tile footstep support
-Fixed objects playing audio over themselves when touched multiple times in a row
-Fix for footstep audio not playing in VR due to camera height
-New audio intros and outtros.
